privileged_info_for_vlm: Chlorine: greenish-yellow, pungent/suffocating, heavier (2.49), adequate warning (threshold 3.5ppm). Carbon Monoxide: colorless, odorless, lighter (0.97), NO warning. Hydrogen Sulfide: colorless, rotten eggs, heavier (1.19), POOR warning (olfactory fatigue at high concentrations). Nitrogen Dioxide: reddish-brown/yellow, pungent, heavier (1.58), poor warning (threshold above TLV). Phosgene: colorless/cloudy, musty hay, heavier (3.4), POOR warning (delayed effects, threshold above safe levels). Ammonia: colorless, pungent, lighter (0.59), adequate warning.
